objective: Hard admissible interior-directed subgoals first, minimum full search time second.
revision_reason: v1 local one-edge masks permitted two corner headings toward another side. Require a finite interior witness for the requested heading rather than assuming one wall is the whole boundary.

constraint.source: Only reflectance-positive table points transformed by encoder odometry
constraint.rule: Candidate ray must intersect eroded interior convex hull. Cap requested length at its certified interior endpoint. If no lattice ray works, align candidate lattice to interior centroid. If none can be certified, abstain.
constraint.release: All sensors table for 0.3s AND body origin inside eroded witness hull
constraint.limits: 8mm is an assumed local geometry allowance, not a measured hardware error bound; convex tables only

network: 32 scored direction/length candidates, 21768 bytes; actual clipped lengths and headings passed in features; same mask training and execution
executor: Same wheel dynamics and steering. Pursuit lookahead is capped at short subgoal length to avoid pursuing beyond the newly shortened target.

training.reward: Same full first-black reward and .002 support penalty; no stronger wheel penalty
training.extra_goal_prior: A finite ray to a verified interior endpoint is allowed even when a body already inside first moves closer to a different side. If body is outside, require inward clearance progress. Do not call a finite inside segment an infinite-ray guarantee.

evaluation.hard_failure: Requested subgoal endpoint outside true arena, OR already outside and requested heading moves farther outside
evaluation.metrics_changed: v1 counted nearest-edge 20mm clearance derivative even for interior starts; v2 additionally certifies complete requested finite goal and separately audits exterior re-entry. All v2 variants use the same new criterion.
ranking: zero wrong directions and zero probability on bad candidate goals
controls: identical warm-start weights plus same certificate gate
two learned policies plus certificate gate
